description: Auto-approve the payment of a purchase prepared by an AI agent only when the purchase request, the supplier's quote and the supplier's registration agree, the registration is approved and current, the quote is current, the amount equals the quote and fits the budget cap, and the amount is within the automated actor's autonomy limit; otherwise escalate to the human approver with one reason per failed condition, in the order listed.
dates: calendar dates YYYY-MM-DD; comparisons are inclusive

conditions.check: each required document kind is submitted exactly once

conditions.reason: request number differs between request and quote
item differs between request and quote
supplier differs between quote and registration

notEvaluated: a condition that reads a missing or duplicated document is not evaluated
